name: Chunked Bounding Box Computation and Normalization
definition: A preprocessing step that divides a list of Gaussian splats into chunks of size `kChunkSize`, computes the bounding box (min/max) for position, scale, color (DC0 + opacity), and spherical harmonics (SH coefficients) for each chunk, and normalizes the splat data within that chunk to the range [0, 1] based on these bounds.
summary: Chunked Bounding Box Computation and Normalization divides Gaussian splats into fixed-size chunks to compute per-chunk bounds and normalize data to [0, 1], ensuring efficient storage in RGBA32F textures.
